description: This file contains unit tests for the RPC (Remote Procedure Call) framework, specifically testing the 'IAdder' interface implementation, proxy/stub setup, and remote invocation mechanisms within the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Tests::Adder
classes.description: A test implementation of the IAdder interface, maintaining an internal value and providing methods to manipulate and retrieve it, along with process ID.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Tests::ExternalAccess
classes.description: A class that manages RPC communication, acquiring remote interface implementations based on interface ID.

methods.name: Adder::GetValue
methods.description: Returns the current value stored in the Adder instance.

methods.name: Adder::Add
methods.description: Adds a given value to the internal stored value.

methods.name: Adder::GetPid
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the Adder instance.

methods.name: ExternalAccess::Acquire
methods.description: Provides remote interface implementation based on interface ID, creating a new Adder if requested.
